purpose: Test one coefficient-free local queue-externality certificate on V117: retain its complete componentwise service construction and require every considered substitution to have no greater admitted-work processor-sharing interference than that player's exact anchor choice.

mechanism_and_outcome_diagnosis.strongest_parent: V117 remains the strongest prior mechanism: spike and sustained passed throughput and both QPR gates; pulse passed throughput and positive mean QPR but failed the two-of-three QPR direction rule.
mechanism_and_outcome_diagnosis.v132_outcome: V132 passed all three pulse gates, passed only spike throughput, and passed no sustained gate. Relative to its paired anchor, spike throughput/QPR changed +0.549/-4.542 percent, sustained -2.423/-6.269 percent, and pulse +0.795/+1.985 percent; both QPR conventions were identical because all runs completed requests.
mechanism_and_outcome_diagnosis.v132_mechanism_falsification: The complete aggregate interference gate was too coarse for the stated local externality hypothesis: among 1,807 active candidate windows it found only 9 aggregate-worse alternatives and performed zero candidate-level interference rejections. The complete V132 cohort is retained and no confirmation input was opened.
mechanism_and_outcome_diagnosis.independent_axis: Replace V132's complete-alternative interference sum with the already-defined V114 per-choice admitted-interference Pareto comparison while retaining V117 componentwise service bit-for-bit. No scenario label, result-derived coefficient, threshold, ratio, horizon, weight, cap, or smoothing width is added.

closed_axes.admitted_work_definition: pending plus all resident remaining plus same-window projected immutable CPU remains bit-for-bit V117
closed_axes.componentwise_per_choice_interference: the sole enabled V133 axis, bit-for-bit V114
closed_axes.completion_proximal_and_terminal_child_a: V123-V131 are failed training branches and are not combined with V133

hypothesis.primary: A substitution can satisfy V117's complete per-player service certificate yet worsen the substituted player's own equal-share interference at the moment the choice is made. A final aggregate sum can hide such offsetting local harm.
hypothesis.candidate: For each V117 service-qualified candidate choice, compute the V114 admitted-interference proxy from pending immutable CPU, every resident remaining CPU item, earlier same-window projected immutable CPU, current-player immutable CPU, and node capacity. Keep the candidate only when the proxy is finite and no greater than the exact anchor choice; then apply every unchanged V117 complete-assignment certificate.
hypothesis.falsification: The hypothesis fails if the sole candidate does not pass every paired throughput and both QPR gates in all three E3 scenarios on the complete fresh E1402-E1404 cohort.

allowed: all immutable and current-state V117 admitted-work, locality, resource, routed-score, OCS, welfare, feasibility, and critical-frontier inputs
the exact per-player V117 anchor node, service-qualified alternative node, prefix assignment, and native player order available before dispatch
pending immutable CPU values, every resident task's finite nonnegative remaining CPU, earlier same-window projected immutable CPU, current-player immutable CPU, and node capacity
forbidden: completion count, throughput, latency, cost, QPR, SLA outcome, or any completed-request aggregate
future arrivals, future completion, future container state, or future child placement
workload scenario, burst label, seed identity, registered burst interval, or time-to-burst-boundary
any result-derived threshold, margin, ratio, horizon, coefficient, cap, or smoothing width
formal E01-E20 outcome-dependent selection or confirmation outcomes before a training pass
information_boundary.componentwise_interference_definition: Bit-for-bit V114 admitted interference for the current player: sum min(x,current_player_work)/node_capacity over every pending immutable CPU value, every resident remaining CPU value, and every earlier same-window projected immutable CPU value in the current prefix.
information_boundary.fail_closed: Any unavailable work value, count mismatch, invalid capacity, nonfinite arithmetic, incomplete assignment, replay infeasibility, componentwise coverage mismatch, or failed frozen V117 certificate preserves the exact anchor choice or assignment.

arms.complete_componentwise_service_rule: every current critical-frontier player's alternative admitted-work service proxy is no greater than its anchor proxy
arms.componentwise_per_choice_interference_ru: every considered substitution has no greater admitted interference than that player's exact anchor choice

candidate_mechanism.only_changed_axis: Enable the coefficient-free V114 componentwise admitted-interference Pareto comparison inside V117's service-qualified candidate choice; every other V117 construction and certificate remains unchanged.
candidate_mechanism.reference_policy: Policy-independent offline reference construction remains unchanged.
candidate_mechanism.exact_anchor_invariant: Without complete finite per-choice interference inputs, a complete finite componentwise service certificate, and every frozen V117 gate, dispatch exact V94 for identical state and candidates.

per_window: all frozen V117 causal-arrival, admitted-work, critical-service, componentwise-service, score, welfare, assignment-hash, and feasibility fields
componentwise admitted-interference gate enabled, anchor and selected proxy, unavailable count, rejected candidate count, and accepted choice count
performance fields retained but not opened before joint blind audit

selection_rule.throughput_gate_per_scenario: candidate three-seed mean is at least the matching anchor mean and candidate-minus-anchor is nonnegative on at least two of three seeds
selection_rule.qpr_gate_per_scenario_per_convention: candidate three-seed mean is strictly greater than the matching anchor mean and candidate-minus-anchor is strictly positive on at least two of three seeds
selection_rule.E3_winner_requires: the sole candidate passes all three metrics in all three E3 scenarios
selection_rule.absolute_formal_n20_baseline_gates: diagnostic only and never used to select the V133 profile
